title: 12 Best Ways to Experience the Iconic Bamboo Norry Train in Battambang
description: Discover the top 12 ways to enjoy Battambang's unique bamboo norry train. From the ride itself to nearby attractions, find tips, prices, and insider info for your Cambodian adventure.
category: Ways to Experience the Iconic Bamboo Norry Train

places.name: O Sra Lau Bamboo Train Station
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A round-trip ticket for the bamboo train.

places.name: Mid-Journey Village & Brick Kiln Stop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing cold drink (like fresh coconut water) or a small, hand-woven souvenir.

places.name: Phnom Sampeau & Bat Cave
places.priceRange: KHR 4,000 (~$1) entrance to mountain, KHR 12,000-20,000 (~$3-5) for moto-taxi up hill
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cold drink from a roadside vendor while waiting for the bat show.

places.name: Bicycle Rental to O Sra Lau Station
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A sturdy mountain bike with gears for the ride.

places.name: Battambang Local Guide Association Services
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A half-day tour package that includes the bamboo train and other nearby attractions.

places.name: Wat Ek Phnom Ancient Temple
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Time to quietly explore the temple ruins and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

places.name: Phnom Banan Winery (Battambang Grape Farm)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of fresh grape juice or a tasting flight of their local 'wine'.

places.name: Psar Nat (Battambang Central Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly cut mango, sticky rice with coconut milk, or local fried bananas.

places.name: Kinyei Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An Iced Khmer Coffee or a refreshing smoothie bowl.

places.name: Soksabike Homestay Experience
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A night's stay including home-cooked meals and local interactions.

places.name: Battambang Provincial Museum
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An hour to quietly browse the exhibits and read the informative placards.

places.name: O Dambong Former Norry Track Viewpoint
places.priceRange: Free (or KHR 4,000-8,000 / ~$1-2 for moto-taxi to view)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A leisurely walk and a fresh coconut from a local vendor if available.

tags: Ways to Experience the Iconic Bamboo Norry Train
